stage_1_reporting.valid_packet_rule: A Stage-1 gate may be PASS or FAIL only when PACKET_VALID=YES and CENSUS_COMPLETE=YES; CENSUS_COMPLETE=NO forces NOT_REPORTABLE_INVALID_PACKET and never permits a shrunken denominator.
stage_1_reporting.empty_universe: If the closed universe denominator N is zero, EMPTY_UNIVERSE=YES, PACKET_VALID_FOR_STAGE1_PASS=NO, SOURCE_STACK_QUALIFIED=NO, and every affected metric is NOT_REPORTABLE_EMPTY_DENOMINATOR.
stage_1_reporting.small_population: For 0 < N < 200, sample_size=min(200,N), without replacement; every selected case remains visible under its frozen unavailable/failure treatment. No uncertainty criterion is added.

universe.asset_object: fungible SPL Token or Token-2022 mint that is the non-quote side of a newly initialized Raydium CPMM pool

market_program.name: raydium-cp-swap
market_program.version_boundary: The frozen program address plus the pinned source/IDL decoder commit and the two discriminators define V0. Any invocation not proven to implement this boundary is UNAVAILABLE_OR_INVALID; an upgrade-history or decoder mismatch prevents census completeness.

observation_window.start: first UTC midnight after future host execution authorization

inclusion: finalized successful Initialize or InitializeWithPermission invokes the frozen CPMM program
distinct sorted mint pair has exactly one fixed-set quote mint and one non-quote mint
complete finalized initialization-time pool, vault, mint, and token-program evidence exists
initialization-time PoolState.status is the known zero-initialized value, so the swap-disabled bit is clear; later current status is never consulted
INITIALIZE_OPEN_TIME_ARGUMENT is decoded and is not later than the non-null initialization blockTime event-time proxy; the stored field is not compared to blockTime
exclusion: two quote mints, two non-quote mints, identical mints, or unsupported token owner
initialization-time status or required initialization evidence cannot be established
INITIALIZE_OPEN_TIME_ARGUMENT after event blockTime, or null event blockTime where this rule is required
universe.newly_active: the first qualifying finalized CPMM initialization for the canonical mint identity across the complete frozen history, not merely the first one observed in the seven-day window

newly_active_history.lower_boundary: Solana genesis slot 0, inclusive; the census searches every finalized frozen-program invocation from this boundary through the window end
newly_active_history.pre_window_exclusion: a mint with any earlier qualifying initialization at slot/time before window_start is excluded from the newly-active window universe; later pools are duplicates
newly_active_history.missing_history: any archive/pruning gap, unresolved page, null required primitive, or unavailable prior-history check yields NEWLY_ACTIVE_HISTORY_COMPLETE=NO, PACKET_VALID=NO, and SOURCE_STACK_QUALIFIED=NO; absence is never treated as no prior pool
newly_active_history.completeness: the historical traversal must close at the genesis boundary before any denominator is valid

raydium_initialization_time_semantics.INITIALIZE_OPEN_TIME_ARGUMENT: the u64 instruction argument decoded after the frozen discriminator
raydium_initialization_time_semantics.INITIALIZED_POOL_STATE_OPEN_TIME: Raydium mutates a local open_time before PoolState initialization: if INITIALIZE_OPEN_TIME_ARGUMENT <= the program Clock unix_timestamp, stored open_time becomes Clock unix_timestamp + 1; otherwise it remains the argument
raydium_initialization_time_semantics.INITIALIZATION_CLOCK_UNIX_TIMESTAMP: the runtime Clock value used by the program; it is distinct from the RPC blockTime estimate
raydium_initialization_time_semantics.LATER_CURRENT_POOL_STATE: mutable PoolState reads fetched after initialization are never used for historical eligibility, market legibility, newly-active classification, or audit population
raydium_initialization_time_semantics.eligibility_rule: V0 uses the initialization argument and initialization-time known zero status; it never applies the impossible stored-open_time <= blockTime predicate. A required initialization-time primitive that cannot be reconstructed without later mutable state is UNAVAILABLE_OR_INVALID.

timestamps.source_slot_or_block: finalized slot plus transaction array index
timestamps.eligibility_knowledge_at: fetched_at of first complete finalized census evidence
timestamps.host_received_at_utc: host wall-clock timestamp captured at the first message callback entry; never a provider-created timestamp
timestamps.fetched_at: provider observation/knowledge timestamp for a request or message, distinct from source_event_at and host receipt
timestamps.recorded_at: local evidence-ledger persistence timestamp, after observation capture
timestamps.non_overlapping_meanings: later corrections append evidence and cannot rewrite any sealed prior timestamp or make a current snapshot historical

market_legibility: initialization-time open-time argument and known initial status, evaluated from the finalized initialization evidence; no later mutable pool snapshot

duplicates_aliases_migrations.dedupe: retain earliest by slot, transaction index, instruction path, signature bytes; link later pools as duplicates
duplicates_aliases_migrations.aliases: metadata aliases, symbols, names, logos, and provider IDs ignored
duplicates_aliases_migrations.migration: new mint address is a new asset; never merge old and new mint

universe.late_observation: event inside window delivered after source-specific 10-minute boundary is LATE and remains in denominator; after census close cannot enter closed snapshot
universe.unavailable_source: UNAVAILABLE, TIMEOUT, MALFORMED, UNSUPPORTED, AMBIGUOUS, or UNAVAILABLE_OR_INVALID; never exclusion, zero, THIN, or parse success

complete_chain_census.enumeration_target: getSignaturesForAddress(CPMMoo8L3F4NbTegBCKVNunggL7H1ZpdTHKxQB5qKP1C) at finalized commitment; the program account is the exact enumeration target
complete_chain_census.observation_range: all finalized program history from slot 0/genesis through the last finalized slot whose blockTime is not later than census_close; candidate inclusion is restricted to [window_start, window_end], while prior-history exclusion uses [genesis, window_start)
complete_chain_census.utc_to_slot_boundaries: resolve and record finalized lower/upper slots by bounded binary search over getBlockTime/getBlock; blockTime is an estimated Unix-second primitive, null or non-monotonic boundary evidence is invalid and forces CENSUS_COMPLETE=NO
complete_chain_census.pagination: pages are newest-to-oldest with limit=1000; first page has no before cursor, each next page uses the prior page's last signature as before, and until is not used to hide history
complete_chain_census.termination: continue until an empty page is returned after the cursor is strictly older, or until the page reaches the genesis lower boundary; a repeated cursor, non-decreasing slot, unexplained missing page, or page ceiling before closure fails completeness
complete_chain_census.signature_deduplication: deduplicate by signature bytes globally while retaining every page/cursor occurrence; conflicting slot/status data is invalid
complete_chain_census.finalized_evidence_mapping: for every required signature, resolve finalized getTransaction and the containing finalized getBlock; verify the signature occurs exactly once at the reported transaction-array index, retain meta.err, blockTime, instruction/account keys, and all required response hashes
complete_chain_census.raydium_discriminator_decoding: decode only the two pinned eight-byte initialization discriminators and their frozen little-endian u64 argument layout; all other instructions are non-census events
complete_chain_census.candidate_mint_extraction: read the frozen initialization account metas and instruction arguments, verify sorted distinct mints, fixed quote-set membership, token-program owners, positive amounts, pool/vault identities, and initialization-time status/open-time evidence
complete_chain_census.prior_history_check: after decoding all historical invocations, group by canonical mint and retain only a mint whose earliest qualifying initialization is inside the seven-day window; any earlier qualifying record excludes it
complete_chain_census.completeness_accounting: record page count, cursors, unique signatures, slot range, block/transaction resolutions, discriminator counts, candidate/exclusion/unavailable counts, prior-history checks, gaps, nulls, retries, request count, bytes, credits, and cost
complete_chain_census.archive_pruning_null_gap_behavior: archive/pruning, null required blockTime or transaction/block primitive, provider gap, rate limit, timeout, malformed response, or unresolved account evidence is UNAVAILABLE_OR_INVALID and makes CENSUS_COMPLETE=NO; it is never exclusion or denominator shrinkage
complete_chain_census.request_ceiling_behavior: if any signature-page or total-RPC ceiling is reached before proof of the termination condition, CENSUS_COMPLETE=NO, PACKET_VALID=NO, UNIVERSE_COVERAGE_GATE=NOT_REPORTABLE_INVALID_PACKET, and SOURCE_STACK_QUALIFIED=NO
complete_chain_census.invariant: CENSUS_COMPLETE=YES only when every required pagination interval is closed, no cursor/page gap exists, every required block/transaction primitive is resolved, all historical exclusion checks complete, no required archive range is unavailable, and no ceiling was reached before proof

providers.product_api_family: Helius LaserStream gRPC raw transactionUpdate filtered to Raydium CPMM initialization
providers.free_paid: mainnet LaserStream documented on Business and higher; paid reference
providers.pricing_model: public Business reference $499/month plus streaming data add-ons/credits; actual usage estimate only
providers.rate_limit_semantics: plan active connections/max pubkeys documented; exact filtered-stream delivery/billing unknown
providers.pagination_semantics: reconnect and historical replay documented; overlap/gap behavior unknown
providers.ordering_semantics: raw slot/transaction ordering to be measured; chain audit is authoritative
providers.timestamp_semantics: source_event_at is finalized transaction blockTime; host_received_at_utc is recorded at callback entry with a monotonic timestamp; provider-created timestamps are never receipt time
providers.stream_commitment: finalized; chosen because the observation claim is about finalized canonical pool initialization events and avoids processed fork/revert ambiguity; no mid-run change
providers.receipt_clock: at first message callback entry record host_received_at_utc from the host wall clock and host_received_monotonic_ns from a monotonic clock, plus the sampled wall-minus-monotonic offset; recalibrate at start/end and invalidate latency if the offset changes or wall clock moves backward
providers.first_observation: first observation is keyed by canonical event identity (chain_id, signature bytes, initialization instruction path, pool, and mint); duplicates never reset it
providers.replay_reconnect: LIVE_FIRST_OBSERVATION is a first event received on the continuously connected finalized stream; REPLAY_RECOVERY is delivered through fromSlot/automatic reconnect replay; DUPLICATE is a later event for an already-seen identity; LATE is a first observation after the frozen 10-minute boundary or after census close. Replay/recovery is never a successful low-latency observation and remains visible with late/unavailable treatment
providers.schema_version_semantics: Yellowstone/gRPC schema and deployed revision to be pinned before execution
providers.historical_live_coverage_claim: documented live transaction monitoring and historical replay; completeness unmeasured
providers.terms_constraint: no unauthorized access, resale, sublicensing, or interference; verify raw-retention rights

INFERRED: raw delivery can be decoded with pinned Raydium IDL without accepting provider semantic labels

source_role_independence.independence_rule: audit uses only separately controlled QuickNode raw JSON-RPC evidence and pinned Raydium interpretation; never Helius output, same-provider wrapper, cache, aggregator, or provider first-buyer ordering
source_role_independence.shared_backend_rule: MARKET_STATE and DIRECT_CHAIN_AUDIT may share the QuickNode backend, but they are not claimed to be independent; market-state evidence is explicitly chain-native and role-labelled
source_role_independence.pre_result_binding: record separate endpoint identity, credential boundary, request hashes, and response hashes before inspecting either first-buyer or audit result
source_role_independence.failure_state: if separate path cannot be bound, AUDIT_SOURCE_INDEPENDENCE_FROZEN=NO and MEASUREMENT_AUTHORIZED=NO

first_buyer_semantics.qualifying_acquisition: successful single-hop Raydium CPMM SwapBaseInput or SwapBaseOutput transferring positive net candidate-mint amount from pool vault to one recipient token-account owner and positive quote amount into paired pool vault
first_buyer_semantics.success: meta.err == null; missing explicit success state is unavailable
first_buyer_semantics.wallet_identity: owner of recipient SPL Token/Token-2022 account; not token-account address, fee payer, pool authority, program, mint authority, or fee account
included_types: CPI token transfers for the frozen pool
first_buyer_semantics.routed_behavior: Jupiter/Raydium router, multiple pools, multiple swaps, or multi-hop transaction is OUT_OF_SCOPE_ROUTED and not a buyer
first_buyer_semantics.duplicates: aggregate same-owner transfer rows within one qualifying swap; later acquisitions do not change first buyer
first_buyer_semantics.ambiguous: multiple positive recipient owners, missing owner, missing required instruction path, or identity collision is AMBIGUOUS
first_buyer_semantics.unavailable: provider/chain failure, missing required field, failed transaction, unsupported parser, or ambiguous case remains unavailable/invalid

chain_order.within_transaction: outer and CPI instruction path order
chain_order.tie_breaker: signature bytes only for duplicate provider records, never missing chain position

audit_population.definition: every distinct canonical asset in the closed universe snapshot with complete outcome-independent mint, pool, initial signature, slot, and vault identity fields

audit_sampling.snapshot: full universe ledger at window end + 30 minutes, RFC8785/JCS bytes and SHA-256 digest committed before result inspection
audit_sampling.selection: unsigned hexadecimal byte sort, first min(200,N)
audit_sampling.commitment: SHA-256 of ordered selected canonical identity list
audit_sampling.unavailable_selected_case: retain in sample and denominator; no discretionary replacement

denominators.logical_case_rule: one stable scheduled case ID; retries are attempts and duplicates do not add denominator rows

parse.numerator: complete valid expected schema and mandatory fields
parse.denominator: all scheduled logical cases for role
parse.invalid_unavailable_malformed_timeout_du: invalid/malformed/timeout/unavailable/late fail parse; duplicates do not inflate; retries can yield final success but malformed payload remains schema evidence

schema.numerator: logical case with at least one non-duplicate received payload violating frozen schema/mandatory fields
schema.denominator: all scheduled logical cases for role
schema.invalid_unavailable_malformed_timeout_du: timeout without payload is not schema violation but is parse failure; duplicate conflict is schema evidence; retries do not change denominator

coverage.numerator: distinct frozen-universe asset with a valid chain-native initialization-time market-state observation joined to the correct mint/pool and eligibility knowledge-time boundary
coverage.denominator: every asset in independent universe snapshot
coverage.invalid_unavailable_malformed_timeout_du: all remain denominator and are not coverage success; missing census evidence cannot remove a case

discovery_latency.numerator: finite source_event_at-to-host_received_at_utc seconds per asset from LIVE_FIRST_OBSERVATION with a valid receipt clock
discovery_latency.invalid_unavailable_malformed_timeout_du: only LIVE_FIRST_OBSERVATION with valid host receipt clock and non-null blockTime is finite; REPLAY_RECOVERY, DUPLICATE, missing, timeout, unavailable, late, or invalid-clock cases remain visible and are +Infinity/not-reportable; p95 index is ceil(0.95*N)-1; duplicates do not inflate

first_buyer_availability.numerator: unambiguous first-buyer answer satisfying frozen semantics
first_buyer_availability.invalid_unavailable_malformed_timeout_du: all are denominator and not availability success

audit_agreement.numerator: selected Helius identity and order exactly match QuickNode-derived chain truth
audit_agreement.invalid_unavailable_malformed_timeout_du: all are denominator and not agreement success; no replacement

semantic_shift.numerator: none; required count is zero undocumented shifts
semantic_shift.denominator: all source observations and schema/semantic changes during run
semantic_shift.invalid_unavailable_malformed_timeout_du: preserve lineage; documented captured versioned change is not undocumented, silent change fails

execution_shape.raw_evidence: request metadata, permitted response bytes/reference, SHA-256, source/schema/parser identity, timestamps, attempts, and costs retained at least 24 months
execution_shape.parser_identity: later harness commit SHA, Node/npm, contract digest, schema revisions, and parser version bound before first request; post-request change creates new packet
execution_shape.cost_accounting: plan, fixed fee, credits, requests, retries, bytes, overages, and invoice/usage evidence per source
execution_shape.semantic_drift_detection: pre-capture docs and timestamps; compare schema, enums, timestamps, order, pagination, missingness throughout; undocumented shift fails
execution_shape.failure_preservation: never delete, hide, or denominator-edit failed, late, duplicate, unavailable, invalid, or selected cases
